reviewed_issues.title: Custom provider validation fails instantly with "Connection timeout - provider node too slow": EYEBALLS_CONNECT 250 ms attempt budget is below one RTT
reviewed_issues.reproduction: On a link with roughly 285ms RTT and dual-stack DNS but no usable IPv6, custom provider validation fails in about 0.5s even though native fetch/curl succeeds. The report compares 250ms vs 2000ms address-attempt budgets.
reviewed_issues.reported_cause: Upstream proxyFetch sets autoSelectFamilyAttemptTimeout:250; validation mislabels connect ETIMEDOUT as slow provider.
reviewed_issues.kitsune_observation: That exact constant/override is absent; Kitsune uses transportPool with configurable 10s total connect deadline and preserves native fetch. No same-bug claim without a connection-attempt reproduction.
reviewed_issues.disposition: Inspect Kitsune transport settings and regression behavior; do not copy the upstream timeout patch blindly.

reviewed_issues.title: tool_choice dropped in chat→Responses translation: explicit client choice degrades to upstream default, model narrates instead of calling
reviewed_issues.reproduction: Chat Completions request with required or named tool_choice sent through a Responses-only model can terminate with narration and no tool call after the choice is dropped.
reviewed_issues.reported_cause: Upstream openaiToOpenAIResponsesRequest omits tool_choice; comment additionally reports missing Chat [DONE] terminal markers.
reviewed_issues.kitsune_observation: Kitsune already preserves tool_choice and flattens named function shape at open-sse/translator/request/openai-responses.js:254; stream.js contains guarded terminal emission.
reviewed_issues.disposition: Validate existing translator and stream contracts; no blind port or claimed new fix.

reviewed_issues.title: 0.5.116: /v1/audio/transcriptions no longer sends a multipart body, STT providers return 400
reviewed_issues.reproduction: POST audio/wav plus model as multipart to /v1/audio/transcriptions; upstream STT returns400 saying Content-Type is not multipart after upgrade0.5.112 to0.5.116.
reviewed_issues.reported_cause: Upstream switched to package Undici fetch while retaining a different global FormData implementation, producing a text serialization instead of multipart boundaries.
reviewed_issues.kitsune_observation: Kitsune STT constructs global FormData, but its proxyFetch retains original native fetch rather than upstream package-fetch replacement. Actual wire validation is required to determine applicability.
reviewed_issues.disposition: Compare multipart binary/headers on the current transport before selective port.
reviewed_issues.later_resolution: Matching multipart serializer and request-local account transport validated locally; final full11772case run passed. Upstream issue remains OPEN at capture.

reviewed_issues.title: Codex Responses API request for gpt-4o appears to reach upstream as deprecated o3-mini
reviewed_issues.reproduction: A single documented Codex Responses request for openai/gpt-4o returned503 mentioning deprecated o3-mini in an installed0.5.119Windows package.
reviewed_issues.reported_cause: Unconfirmed. Reporter explicitly found no hardcoded or persisted mapping and had no readable runtime trace.
reviewed_issues.kitsune_observation: No verified current Kitsune model-substitution reproduction in this discovery task.
reviewed_issues.disposition: Retain explicit model identity invariants and investigate reproducible dispatch traces; do not invent an o3-mini rewrite fix.

reviewed_issues.title: kimi k3.1 pro reports 200k context window
reviewed_issues.reproduction: Kimi provider bare model ID k3.1-pro reports a generic200K context instead of the model maximum.
reviewed_issues.reported_cause: Bare Kimi Code IDs k3.1-pro/k3.1-pro-highspeed are absent while prefixed kimi-k3.1-pro metadata exists.
reviewed_issues.kitsune_observation: Official current Kimi Code source confirms /models Bearer accessToken and native limit.context; Kitsune OAuth catalog is skipped and generic parser omits limit.context. Bare k3.1-pro static1M limit remains unverified because official model documentation is network-blocked.
reviewed_issues.disposition: Implemented Kimi OAuth/API-key native catalog discovery and positive safe-integer limit.context propagation, including exact account model IDs, complete empty catalogs, and unknown token ceilings. No static1M model claim or new billing inference; upstream issue remains OPEN.

reviewed_issues.reproduction: Initial curl through Antigravity Gemini succeeds, a Claude Code request fails503 with model cooldown, and later curl also fails.
reviewed_issues.reported_cause: Unconfirmed; report does not distinguish provider throttling, request rejection, or router account-health classification.
reviewed_issues.kitsune_observation: No live provider credentials or controlled account test used.
reviewed_issues.disposition: Preserve documented validation vs quota distinctions and explicit permanent denials; only change code after a local synthetic reproduction.

reviewed_issues.title: Antigravity requests fail
reviewed_issues.reproduction: Account connection check succeeds while real Antigravity requests return resource exhausted.
reviewed_issues.reported_cause: Comments allege prompt-triggered responses and account enforcement; these are operator reports, not independently verified universal quota diagnoses.
reviewed_issues.kitsune_observation: No live requests/account testing in this audit.
reviewed_issues.disposition: Do not import prompt rewriting, identity stripping, or account-enforcement evasion. Preserve clear error diagnostics and supported authentication behavior.

reviewed_issues.title: Antigravity returns prompt-triggered 429 for OpenClaw system identity sentence
reviewed_issues.reproduction: Reporter claims an exact OpenClaw system identity sentence yields429 while shorter/reworded variants do not.
reviewed_issues.reported_cause: Alleged upstream identity/content-based restriction, not an established general quota cause.

reviewed_issues.disposition: No anti-detection or restriction-bypass rewrite is authorized by this technical compatibility audit. Treat account/service denials explicitly.
